description: UCI row 6 (age 53, LOW vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 6, horizon 3yr) — government bond: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Ingeborg Haas is 53 years old and works as a human resources manager at a manufacturing company. She earns roughly 65,500 euros per year and holds 43,300 euros in liquid savings. She wants to invest 3,600 euros for about 3 years to generate stable returns ahead of a planned early retirement. She has basic investment knowledge: she has previously held government bond funds and blue-chip equity funds through her bank but has no experience with complex or leveraged products. She rates her risk tolerance at 6 out of 10 and has confirmed she can afford to lose the invested amount. Her primary objective is capital preservation.
product_narrative: The product is a eurozone government bond issued by a sovereign member state of the EU, rated AA or above by major credit rating agencies. The bond pays a fixed annual coupon and returns principal at maturity. It is non-complex under MiFID II, requires only basic financial knowledge to understand, and has a minimum recommended holding period of three years. The bond is listed on regulated markets, publishes a prospectus and KID equivalent, uses no leverage, and in the worst case delivers only partial capital loss (credit event).
